text:
Mara: Heads-up — SolarFlare case story: we have raw recording + a rough transcript. Need a publish-ready transcript, CEO quote approval, and legal sign-off by end of day Friday. Also trying to lock a webinar slot (week of Apr 7). Drive with assets here: https://rwd.in/sf-recordings. Who can own approvals?
Jordan: I can clean the transcript today. Will pull key soundbites and make a 60/30/15 sec clip list.
Nina (Demand): Apr 7 week is tight but we have a 45-min webinar slot Tuesday AM. Want to pair the publish with webinar promo — need final quote by Thu at the latest for copy.
Sam (Legal): Quick checklist — we need (1) signed quote release from CEO, (2) confirmation there are no embargoed third-party stats in the transcript, (3) any sensitive IP redactions. I can review once Jordan shares cleaned transcript.
Riley (Prod): Recorded a short demo clip that we may want to include. File is in the drive under /clips/demo-v2.mp4. Might need a tiny caption edit for privacy.
Jordan: Working now. Plan: clean transcript + timestamped clip list by 2pm. Will flag any redacted bits inline like [REDACTED].
Mara: @Jordan awesome. @Sam can you outline the release language we need? Would prefer to attach a permission email template we can send to SolarFlare's comms team.
Sam (Legal): Draft permission email for quotes: 
```
Subject: Quick approval request — Redwood x SolarFlare quote
Hi [Name],
Thanks again for speaking with us. Attached is the edited transcript and a proposed short quote for use in our case story and promotional materials. Please reply with approval or edits by EOD Thu. By approving, you confirm permission to publish the quote and materials.
Best,
Sam (Legal)
```
Use that and ping me if they propose edits that change meaning.
Nina (Demand): For promo cadence — we can announce on release day + 2 reminder emails. Need final logos, quote, and 1 hero screenshot 24 hrs before launch. Can we commit to that?
Jordan: Yes to the screenshot; I'll export hero stills from the recording and drop options by 3pm.
Mara: Who will send the permission email? I can, but want Sam on cc for legal trail.
Sam (Legal): Mara please send, CC me. I'll add a short release clause in the body.
publishing-bot: New checklist created: #SF-caseflow-2964. Items: transcript-clean, quote-request-sent, legal-review, asset-export, webinar-slot-confirmed.
Riley (Prod): Small note — demo clip contains customer PII at 00:01:24. Jordan mark for redaction and I can re-export masked clip.
Jordan: Marked [REDACTED — PII] at 00:01:24 and 00:02:03. Will remove those segments and update clip timestamps.
Mara: Plan recap: Jordan cleans transcript + clips by 3pm, Mara sends permission email with Sam cc by 4pm, Sam reviews approvals and flags any legal edits asap, Nina holds Apr 7 webinar slot tentative pending quote. Riley to re-export masked demo if needed. Publishing-bot will track.
Nina (Demand): I'll tentatively schedule the webinar invite to internal calendar and loop in Sales. If quote clears earlier we can push the promo live same week.
Sam (Legal): One ask — if SolarFlare proposes an edited quote that changes technical claims, route it to @Riley for product sign-off before we accept.
Mara: Copy. Jordan — put any suggested quote edits in the doc and tag Riley.
Jordan: Will do. Dropping first draft transcript and clip list now: https://rwd.in/sf-drafts/transcript-v1.md 
Mara: Thanks — I'll check in at 5pm. :thumbsup: 
publishing-bot: Checklist update: transcript-clean (in_progress) -> transcript-clean (done) at 2964120650
Sam (Legal): Received the draft, starting review. If everything looks good I'll prepare the permission email and the release clause.
Jordan: Updated clip list with safe/unsafe flags. Added proposed 2-line quote candidates (short + long).
Mara: Great work. Last thing — can we get a 15-30 sec micro-clip for social? Nina, Riley — can you decide which moment to prioritize?
Nina (Demand): Prioritize the CEO soundbite at ~00:03:10 if it's approved. That will be highest impact for registration.
Riley (Prod): Confirmed — if legal clears the soundbite, I'll export micro-clip + add captions.
Mara: Perfect. End-of-day target remains Friday for final sign-off. Thanks team.
publishing-bot: Checklist update: quote-request-sent -> pending_approval at 2964120715
